stage: DEC-057 reserve plan 3 (sealed before its TDS)

runs.purpose: RESERVE (logged justification, H9c discrimination): the frozen-time linearisation of plant + B2 along the INS run is validated by an independent FD Jacobian (1e-7) and has a 1.30 Hz pair at +0.58 1/s from t = 200 s, but the default TDS (lazy chord-Newton Jacobian, convergence on |increment| <= 1e-4) shows no growth until ~312 s (dt) / ~334 s (dt/2). Same configuration with the Jacobian refreshed at every iteration and tol 1e-8. PREDICTION if the late onset is a solver artifact: growth of the 1.25-1.3 Hz component starts at the time the frozen-time pair crosses Re = 0 (from this run's own snapshots), well before 300 s; otherwise onset within +-5 s of the default run
